$comment: The bar. Read-only at runtime: no API path writes this file. See setpoint/README.md and docs/concepts/SETPOINT-MODEL.md.

confidence.rationale: Bars sit at operation granularity. The obligation list they should derive from — what the infra-health team must be able to do — has never been written, and no control layer has authored a space doc yet. Confidence cannot rise above SKETCH until both exist.

migration.note: The 14 authored target kinds have not been migrated yet. Bars are deliberately empty rather than pre-populated: a bar must name a cell, and no control layer has authored a space doc for its cells to exist in. Populating bars against cell refs that do not resolve would fail the setpoint-integrity check on its first run and would encode guesses about spaces their owners have not written. Migration is a plan phase and runs after the first owner space docs land.
migration.on_completion: docs/infra-health/strategy/RELIABILITY_TARGETS.md keeps its operating-model and governance content and points here for the bars; docs/infra-health/evidence/INSTRUMENTATION_ROADMAP.md is replaced by the computed open-loop set.
